name: Cup and saucer
dimensions: Height 5.1 cm; Diameter 8.9 cm; Diameter 13.3 cm
summary:
The scene on this cup and saucer depicts a young man courting a shepherdess seated by a fountain, surmounted by the figure of a putto, while sheeps and two dogs are painted in the background and foreground.
